verdict.rationale:
Zep automatically ingests raw chat messages into a Context Graph, extracting entities/edges and generating/incrementally updating thread summaries without explicit user tagging (zep-docs-20, zep-docs-8, zep-docs-27, zep-gh-1/2). This background salience-extraction and consolidation is the product's core differentiator, and the founder/community threads confirm the design intent and the underlying temporal-graph mechanics (zep-comm-1, zep-comm-3).
Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmark showing extraction accuracy at scale, and clarity on how custom entity/edge schemas (zep-docs-3) interact with 'fully automatic' extraction (some configuration may be needed for best results); also community critique (zep-comm-4) about non-deterministic LLM-generated schemas keeps confidence from being high.
